headline: Level Cap Promotion
title: Stuck at Level Cap | Pathfinder Promotion | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Stuck at your level cap in Aniimo? You need a promotion. At level twenty five, finish the required Core Courses in your Elite Training chapter, then take the assessment, a duel followed by a theory quiz with Dr. Lewis. Pass it and the cap rises to thirty five. After that the caps climb to forty, forty five, fifty and beyond, one chapter at a time. What is your cap? Comment below!
description: How to raise your level cap in Aniimo: complete the required Core Courses in your Elite Training chapter, pass the Pathfinder promotion assessment (a duel and a theory quiz with Dr. Lewis) and the cap rises, for example from 25 to 35.
